Script.name: BlingMUD GMCP Mapper
Script.script:
BlingMUD = BlingMUD or {} BlingMUD.mapper = BlingMUD.mapper or {}
local mapper = BlingMUD.mapper
mapper.version = "1.0.0" mapper.maximumRoomID = 1000000 mapper.maximumAreaLength = 128 mapper.maximumNameLength = 256 mapper.maximumExits = 12 mapper.walkTimeoutSeconds = 3
mudlet = mudlet or {} mudlet.mapper_script = true
local directions = { n = {0, 1, 0}, ne = {1, 1, 0}, e = {1, 0, 0}, se = {1, -1, 0}, s = {0, -1, 0}, sw = {-1, -1, 0}, w = {-1, 0, 0}, nw = {-1, 1, 0}, u = {0, 0, 1}, d = {0, 0, -1}, ["in"] = {0, 0, 0}, out = {0, 0, 0}, }
local directionAliases = { north = "n", northeast = "ne", east = "e", southeast = "se", south = "s", southwest = "sw", west = "w", northwest = "nw", up = "u", down = "d", ["in"] = "in", out = "out", }
for direction in pairs(directions) do directionAliases[direction] = direction end
local function positiveInteger(value) return type(value) == "number" and value >= 1 and value <= mapper.maximumRoomID and value == math.floor(value) end
local function boundedText(value, maximum) return type(value) == "string" and value ~= "" and #value <= maximum end
local function normalizeDirection(value) if type(value) ~= "string" then return nil end
return directionAliases[string.lower(value)] end
local function roomHash(serverRoomID) return "BlingMUD:" .. tostring(serverRoomID) end
local function areaID(areaName) local areas = getAreaTable() or {} local existing = areas[areaName]
if type(existing) == "number" and existing >= 1 then return existing end
local created, message = addAreaName(areaName)
if type(created) ~= "number" or created < 1 then return nil, message or "could not create the map area" end
return created end
local function ensureRoom(serverRoomID, targetAreaID, x, y, z) local hash = roomHash(serverRoomID) local mudletRoomID = getRoomIDbyHash(hash) local created = false
if type(mudletRoomID) ~= "number" or mudletRoomID < 1 then mudletRoomID = createRoomID()
if type(mudletRoomID) ~= "number" or mudletRoomID < 1 then return nil, false, "could not allocate a Mudlet room ID" end
local added, message = addRoom(mudletRoomID, targetAreaID)
if not added then return nil, false, message or "could not add a Mudlet room" end
setRoomIDbyHash(mudletRoomID, hash) setRoomCoordinates(mudletRoomID, x or 0, y or 0, z or 0) setRoomName(mudletRoomID, "Unvisited BlingMUD room " .. tostring(serverRoomID)) created = true else setRoomArea(mudletRoomID, targetAreaID) end
setRoomUserData(mudletRoomID, "blingmud.room_id", tostring(serverRoomID)) return mudletRoomID, created end
local function validateRoomInfo(info) if type(info) ~= "table" or not positiveInteger(info.num) or not boundedText(info.name, mapper.maximumNameLength) or not boundedText(info.area, mapper.maximumAreaLength) or type(info.exits) ~= "table" then return nil, "invalid Room.Info header" end
local exits = {} local count = 0
for rawDirection, destination in pairs(info.exits) do local direction = normalizeDirection(rawDirection)
if direction == nil or not positiveInteger(destination) then return nil, "invalid Room.Info exit" end
if exits[direction] == nil then count = count + 1 end
if count > mapper.maximumExits then return nil, "too many Room.Info exits" end
exits[direction] = destination end
return { num = info.num, name = info.name, area = info.area, exits = exits, } end
local function stopWalk(message, finished) local walk = mapper.walk
if not walk or not walk.active then return end
walk.active = false walk.generation = walk.generation + 1
if walk.timer then pcall(killTimer, walk.timer) walk.timer = nil end
if finished then raiseEvent("sysSpeedwalkFinished") else raiseEvent("sysSpeedwalkStopped")
if message and cecho then cecho("\n<orange>BlingMUD mapper:<reset> " .. message .. "\n") end end end
local function sendWalkStep() local walk = mapper.walk
if not walk or not walk.active then return end
if walk.index > #walk.directions then stopWalk(nil, true) return end
local direction = walk.directions[walk.index] local generation = walk.generation send("/" .. direction, true) walk.timer = tempTimer(mapper.walkTimeoutSeconds, function() local current = mapper.walk
if current and current.active and current.generation == generation then stopWalk("speedwalk stopped because the room change was not confirmed", false) end end) end
local function confirmWalkStep(mudletRoomID) local walk = mapper.walk
if not walk or not walk.active then return end
local expected = walk.path[walk.index]
if mudletRoomID ~= expected then stopWalk("speedwalk stopped after an unexpected room change", false) return end
if walk.timer then pcall(killTimer, walk.timer) walk.timer = nil end
walk.index = walk.index + 1
if walk.index > #walk.directions then stopWalk(nil, true) else tempTimer(0, sendWalkStep) end end
function mapper.updateRoom(rawInfo) local info, validationError = validateRoomInfo(rawInfo)
if not info then return false, validationError end
local targetAreaID, areaError = areaID(info.area)
if not targetAreaID then return false, areaError end
local mudletRoomID, _, roomError = ensureRoom( info.num, targetAreaID, 0, 0, 0 )
if not mudletRoomID then return false, roomError end
setRoomName(mudletRoomID, info.name) setRoomArea(mudletRoomID, targetAreaID)
local currentX, currentY, currentZ = getRoomCoordinates(mudletRoomID) currentX = currentX or 0 currentY = currentY or 0 currentZ = currentZ or 0
local desired = {}
for direction, destination in pairs(info.exits) do local offset = directions[direction] local destinationID, _, destinationError = ensureRoom( destination, targetAreaID, currentX + offset[1], currentY + offset[2], currentZ + offset[3] )
if not destinationID then return false, destinationError end
desired[direction] = destinationID
if not setExit(mudletRoomID, destinationID, direction) then return false, "could not set a Mudlet room exit" end end
for direction in pairs(getRoomExits(mudletRoomID) or {}) do local normalized = normalizeDirection(direction)
if normalized and desired[normalized] == nil then setExit(mudletRoomID, -1, normalized) end end
mapper.currentRoom = mudletRoomID mapper.currentServerRoom = info.num centerview(mudletRoomID)
if type(updateMap) == "function" then updateMap() end
confirmWalkStep(mudletRoomID) return true end
function mapper.onRoomInfo() local info = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info local ok, result, message = pcall(mapper.updateRoom, info)
if not ok then message = result result = false end
if not result and cecho then cecho("\n<orange>BlingMUD mapper ignored Room.Info:<reset> " .. tostring(message or "unknown error") .. "\n") end end
function mapper.requestRoomInfo() if type(gmod) == "table" and type(gmod.enableModule) == "function" then gmod.enableModule("BlingMUD", "Room") elseif type(sendGMCP) == "function" then sendGMCP('Core.Supports.Add ["Room 1"]') end end
function mapper.onProtocolEnabled(_, protocol) if protocol == "GMCP" then mapper.requestRoomInfo() end end
function mapper.startSpeedwalk(rawDirections, rawPath) if type(rawDirections) ~= "table" or type(rawPath) ~= "table" or #rawDirections == 0 or #rawDirections ~= #rawPath or #rawDirections > 128 then return false end
local walkDirections = {} local walkPath = {}
for index = 1, #rawDirections do local direction = normalizeDirection(rawDirections[index])
if direction == nil or type(rawPath[index]) ~= "number" or rawPath[index] < 1 then return false end
walkDirections[index] = direction walkPath[index] = rawPath[index] end
if mapper.walk and mapper.walk.active then stopWalk("replaced by a new speedwalk", false) end
mapper.walkGeneration = (mapper.walkGeneration or 0) + 1 mapper.walk = { active = true, directions = walkDirections, generation = mapper.walkGeneration, index = 1, path = walkPath, }
raiseEvent("sysSpeedwalkStarted") sendWalkStep() return true end
if not mapper.speedwalkHookCaptured then mapper.hadPreviousDoSpeedWalk = type(doSpeedWalk) == "function" mapper.previousDoSpeedWalk = doSpeedWalk mapper.speedwalkHookCaptured = true end
function mapper.doSpeedWalk() if not mapper.startSpeedwalk(speedWalkDir, speedWalkPath) and cecho then cecho("\n<orange>BlingMUD mapper:<reset> no usable path to that room\n") end end
function mapper.installSpeedwalk() doSpeedWalk = mapper.doSpeedWalk end
mapper.installSpeedwalk()
function mapper.onConnection() if mapper.walk and mapper.walk.active then stopWalk("connection changed", false) end
-- Reapply this after all profile packages have loaded. The bundled generic -- mapper otherwise installs a bare-command speedwalk function of its own. mapper.installSpeedwalk() end
function mapper.onUninstall(_, packageName) if packageName ~= "BlingMUD" then return end
if mapper.walk and mapper.walk.active then stopWalk("package uninstalled", false) end
if mapper.handlers then for _, handlerID in ipairs(mapper.handlers) do pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, handlerID) end
mapper.handlers = {} end
if doSpeedWalk == mapper.doSpeedWalk then if mapper.hadPreviousDoSpeedWalk then doSpeedWalk = mapper.previousDoSpeedWalk else doSpeedWalk = nil end end
mapper.previousDoSpeedWalk = nil mapper.hadPreviousDoSpeedWalk = nil mapper.speedwalkHookCaptured = nil
if type(gmod) == "table" and type(gmod.disableModule) == "function" then gmod.disableModule("BlingMUD", "Room") end end
if mapper.handlers then for _, handlerID in ipairs(mapper.handlers) do pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, handlerID) end end
mapper.handlers = { registerAnonymousEventHandler("gmcp.Room.Info", mapper.onRoomInfo), registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysProtocolEnabled", mapper.onProtocolEnabled), registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysConnectionEvent", mapper.onConnection), registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysUninstallPackage", mapper.onUninstall), }
if type(map) == "table" and map.mapping then if type(map.set) == "function" then pcall(map.set, "mapping", false) else map.mapping = false end end
mapper.requestRoomInfo()
if gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info then tempTimer(0, mapper.onRoomInfo) end
if not mapper.loadedMessageShown and cecho then mapper.loadedMessageShown = true cecho("\n<green>BlingMUD GMCP mapper active.<reset> Mapping starts automatically.\n") end
